overview.pattern: Pure-CLI/TUI cache-first agentic loop with a modular tool registry
overview.description: reasonix-legacy is a DeepSeek-native coding agent delivered exclusively as a CLI/TUI (binaries reasonix / dsnix). The web dashboard, HTTP server (src/server/router.ts), and Tauri desktop shell were removed in v1.0 (~16.9k lines). The core abstraction is CacheFirstLoop (src/loop.ts): stream model completions, dispatch tool calls via ToolRegistry, repair malformed output (src/repair), shrink oversized context (src/loop/shrink.ts), fold history (src/context-manager.ts), and persist a transcript. The model is accessed only through DeepSeekClient (src/client.ts); concrete tool/memory/hook implementations are decoupled via the src/ports interfaces.

data-flow.flow: CLI argv -> resolveDefaults -> chatCommand/runCommand/codeCommand -> CacheFirstLoop -> DeepSeekClient(stream) -> tool dispatch -> tool results -> context shrink/fold -> next turn -> transcript log
data-flow.description: User input enters via the Ink TUI (chat/code), one-shot (run), ACP (editor), or a chat-bot channel (qq/telegram/weixin). The loop accumulates messages in a ContextManager; on each turn it streams a DeepSeek completion, parses tool calls, dispatches them chunked (loop/dispatch.ts), appends results (possibly truncated/saved-to-disk), and continues until the model stops emitting tool calls. A transcript is written incrementally (transcript/log.ts).

ports-and-adapters.description: src/ports/ defines abstract interfaces (model-client, tool-host, event-sink, hook-runner, memory-store, checkpoint-store); src/adapters/ provides concrete JSONL implementations. DeepSeekClient and ToolRegistry are the default adapters wired by the command entry points. ACP and the channel bots swap implementations without touching the loop.

tui-runtime.pattern: Custom Ink fork (React reconciler -> Yoga -> terminal)
tui-runtime.description: A forked Ink runtime lives at packages/ink (path-aliased as 'ink' in tsconfig.json). It renders React 19 components via react-reconciler + yoga-layout into a diff-based terminal screen. The chat/code TUI (src/cli/ui/App.tsx and supporting components) is the primary UX, and the fork exposes `forceRedraw()` through AppContext so `/new`, `/clear`, and `/reset` can request a full repaint when incremental clearing leaves terminal artifacts.

conventions.naming: kebab-case filenames, camelCase identifiers, PascalCase types/components. CLI subcommands are verbs (run/chat/code/commit/stats/sessions).
conventions.file-organization: src/ is grouped by subsystem (loop, tools, mcp, repair, memory, transcript, telemetry, code, code-query, index/semantic, cli, acp, qq/telegram/weixin, core, ports, adapters, net, i18n, java). Each tool registers itself via a registerXTools() function. Barrel exports in src/index.ts expose the public library API. No src/server or src/desktop directories exist (removed v1.0).
conventions.imports: ESM throughout (type: module). Relative .js specifiers even between .ts files (NodeNext-style). Path aliases: '@/*' -> src/*, 'ink' -> packages/ink/src/index.ts.
conventions.error-style: Loop errors are classified in src/loop/errors.ts (4xx/5xx/host-reachability); aborts yield a synthetic [aborted by user] message rather than throwing.
conventions.testing: Vitest unit tests in tests/ (pool: forks, retry: 1 for Windows scheduler tolerance), mutation testing via Stryker, component tests via jsdom + @testing-library/react + ink-testing-library. Public-API surface snapshotted in tests/public-api.test.ts.

build.description: tsup produces two ESM bundles: a library (src/index.ts -> dist/index.js, with dts) and a CLI (src/cli/index.ts -> dist/cli/index.js, noExternal:[/.*/] with a require-shim banner). Post-build scripts write the CLI package marker and copy tree-sitter .wasm grammars into dist. The tokenizer data (data/deepseek-tokenizer.json.gz) is shipped in the npm package. No Vite/Tauri/dashboard build remains.

i18n.description: i18n runtime (src/i18n/index.ts) loads exactly two locales — en (src/i18n/EN.ts) and zh-CN (src/i18n/zh-CN.ts); getSupportedLanguages() returns ['en','zh-CN']. JA/de/ru locales were removed in Phase 7 of the v1.1 cleanup. t()/tObj() lookups fall back to en. Locale detection honours LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG and Intl locale, mapping zh* -> zh-CN.

security.pattern: Tool allow-lists + confirmation gates + event redaction
security.description: With the dashboard HTTP server removed, there is no network attack surface left in the core: it is loopback-free and CLI-only. Shell tools enforce an allow-list (isAllowed) and require confirmation via PauseGate. Event redaction strips secrets before emission (src/core/event-redaction.ts). API keys are read from env/config and never logged.

repair-pipeline.description: Models occasionally emit malformed/truncated tool calls. src/repair implements scavenge (recover tool calls from free text), truncation repair (close truncated JSON), schema flatten/nest (coerce args to the declared JSON schema), and StormBreaker (halt runaway tool-call storms). Exposed as ToolCallRepair and applied inside the loop's healing step (src/loop/healing.ts).

mcp-integration.pattern: Pluggable MCP transports bridged into the ToolRegistry
mcp-integration.description: src/mcp implements a JSON-RPC client over three transports (stdio, sse, streamable-http). bridgeMcpTools() adapts remote MCP tools into local ToolDefinitions with result flattening and per-token truncation (truncateForModelByTokens). An interactive marketplace browser (mcp-browse command/TUI) and inspector (mcp-inspect) aid discovery.

memory-tiers.pattern: Immutable prefix + append-only log + volatile scratch; project/user/session scopes
memory-tiers.description: Runtime memory (src/memory/runtime.ts) splits the system prompt into ImmutablePrefix (cache-friendly, locale-independent sortToolSpecs), AppendOnlyLog, and VolatileScratch. Project memory (PROJECT_MEMORY_FILE), user MemoryStore, and per-session logs (src/memory/session.ts) are layered via applyMemoryStack when the system prompt is rebuilt.

context-management.description: ContextManager (src/context-manager.ts) tracks token usage and folds old turns past TURN_START_FOLD_THRESHOLD. src/loop/shrink.ts shrinks oversized tool-call args and tool results (by chars or tokens). src/loop/reasoning-retention.ts strips droppable reasoning content across turns to preserve cache prefix stability.

semantic-index.pattern: Optional local vector index over the workspace
semantic-index.description: src/index/semantic builds an embedding index (chunker + embedding provider, Ollama supported via ollama-launcher). The semantic tool (tool.ts) and the `reasonix index` command expose code-aware retrieval. Configured via src/index/config.ts and gated by semanticPreflight.

remote-channels.pattern: CLI-hosted headless chat bots (QQ, Telegram, WeChat)
remote-channels.description: After desktop/dashboard removal, the three chat networks are exposed purely as CLI subcommands: `reasonix qq`, `reasonix telegram`, `reasonix weixin`. Each lives under src/<channel>/ (bot.ts EventEmitter + channel.ts + access.ts + use-*-channel.ts hook + strings.ts) and is driven by a thin command at src/cli/commands/<channel>.ts. The retired `reasonix desktop` subcommand is kept only as an error stub redirecting users to these commands. They forward messages into the same CacheFirstLoop and route replies back.

governance.description: v1.1 introduced governance hardening: machine intel under .planning/intel/, human-readable docs under .planning/codebase/, critical-path tests, and CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) pinning node 22 on ubuntu-latest + windows-latest with a cross-platform Vitest retry wrapper (scripts/ci-test-with-retry.mjs) for flaky visibility on active branches.

component:DeepSeekClient.responsibility: DeepSeek API HTTP client: chat completions (stream + non-stream), usage accounting, model list, balance.

component:CacheFirstLoop.responsibility: Main agent loop: turn iteration, tool dispatch, healing, shrink, hook events, transcript writes.

component:ToolRegistry.responsibility: Registers ToolDefinitions; supports interceptors, result augmenters, audit listeners, allow-lists, plan-mode gating, rate limiting.

component:ContextManager.responsibility: Tracks token usage and folds old messages past threshold (normal/aggressive/forced-summary).

component:ToolCallRepair.responsibility: Scavenge, truncation repair, schema flatten/nest, storm-breaking.

component:InkRuntime.responsibility: Forked Ink TUI runtime (React reconciler + Yoga + terminal renderer).

component:ChatTUI.responsibility: Interactive chat TUI app (Ink React tree).

component:SemanticIndex.responsibility: Builds and queries an embedding index over the workspace.

component:ACP.responsibility: Agent Client Protocol stdio JSON-RPC server (editor/IDE integration).

component:Hooks.responsibility: Loads + runs configured shell hooks on tool events.

component:ChannelBots.responsibility: CLI-hosted headless QQ/Telegram/WeChat bot adapters driving the same CacheFirstLoop.

component:I18n.responsibility: Bilingual (en/zh-CN) message lookup, locale detection, fallback.

maintenance-surface.pattern: Maintained-fork user surfaces with archived upstream references
maintenance-surface.description: User-facing docs, issue-report flows, and `/about` links point at the maintained `ZYist/reasonix-legacy` GitHub repository and docs tree. Historical upstream website/design assets remain archived under `docs/archive/upstream-reasonix/` as a read-only reference for copy, structure, and TUI/MCP presentation cues.

terminal-session-identity.pattern: Persistent terminal title identity for interactive entrypoints
terminal-session-identity.description: Interactive CLI/TUI entrypoints call `setTabTitle()` from `src/cli/tab-title.ts` to emit OSC 0 title sequences for `reasonix-legacy`. The keeper periodically re-emits the title on TTY stdout so Windows ConPTY and spawned processes do not permanently override the visible tab title.
